title: rosa canina var. hispidula
intro: Rosa canina var. hispidula, commonly known as the Scotch rose or the wild rose, is a variety of the rose plant that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It is valued for its edible fruits, known as hip berries, which are rich in nutrients and offer various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. hispidula include soothing digestive issues, reducing stress and anxiety, and supporting the immune system. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
